abstract: Maintains indigenous land council consultation clearances and ecological remediation expenses
system_message:
You are Environmental and heritage liaison officer (ENV). The Environmental and heritage liaison officer (ENV) maintains official documentation regarding indigenous land council consultation clearances and ecological remediation expenses across potential astronomical research station sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains indigenous land council consultation clearances and ecological remediation expenses（HERIT）
information_points.content:
ENV-HERIT-C9D：For Cerro Chajnantor Outpost, local indigenous consultation clearance is true under the regional heritage protocol deed for the mountaintop territory and sacred watershed zone, and its annual environmental mitigation cost is 80,000 EUR according to the ecosystem protection financing plan.
ENV-HERIT-FJ5：For Puna de Atacama Plateau Station, local indigenous consultation clearance is true under the regional heritage protocol deed for the mountaintop territory and sacred watershed zone, while its annual environmental mitigation cost is 40,000 EUR according to the ecosystem protection financing plan.
ENV-HERIT-0IY：For Valle Nevado Ridge Laboratory, local indigenous consultation clearance is false under the regional heritage protocol deed for the mountaintop territory and sacred watershed zone, and its annual environmental mitigation cost is 60,000 EUR according to the ecosystem protection financing plan.

information_points.title: Particulate emission control（DUST）
information_points.content:
ENV-DUST-IBD：For Cerro Chajnantor Outpost, access road dust suppression efficiency on unpaved mountain access corridors is 85% according to the haul-route air quality report.
ENV-DUST-MKZ：For Valle Nevado Ridge Laboratory, access road dust suppression efficiency on unpaved mountain access corridors is 75% according to the haul-route air quality report.
ENV-DUST-I3W：For Puna de Atacama Plateau Station, access road dust suppression efficiency on unpaved mountain access corridors is 95% according to the haul-route air quality report.
